title.narrative: Enhancing disability policy coordination mechanism in Greece

description.narrative:
Greece, having ratified the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UNCRPD), is committed to developing policies that align with the UNCRPD and improve the lives of persons with disabilities, in line with the EU Strategy for the rights of people with disabilities. To deliver this across different administrative levels, Greece has instituted through Law 4488/2017 a Coordinating Mechanism on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. The project is designed to enhance the capacity of this Coordinating Mechanism.
The request by Greece is funded by, and receives technical support from, the European Commission under Regulation (EU) 2021/240 establishing the Technical Support Instrument, with the Directorate-General for Structural Reform Support acting as the contracting authority and UNESCO as the implementing agency.
